notes: Sufyan takes the report from two co-transmitters in one level: عمرو and ابن، طاوس; then طاوس, then ابن عباس.
In the scene «قال عمرو فقلت له» the same عمرو speaks but is not a link (rule 6). The inline «يعني ابن عباس» is the compiler's identification of the source; it is read as the link's name (rule 9).
